name: Obadiah
overview: Obadiah was a male member of the tribe of Judah, uniquely identified as the son of Hananiah. His mention is concise, with no additional notes provided to expand on his role or significance beyond his lineage. This brief record situates him within the genealogical context of Judah.
namesAndTitles: The name Obadiah means 'servant [worshiper] of YHWH,' reflecting a dedication to the Lord. This proper name was not given directly by God but carries a clear theological meaning consistent with a faithful servant of God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Obadiah as the son of Hananiah, establishing a direct paternal relationship. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Obadiah's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Judah as the son of Hananiah. While there are no further details about his life or actions, his inclusion in the biblical record underscores the importance of lineage and heritage in God's covenant people. His name also reflects a heart of worship toward the Lord, which aligns with the faithful character expected of Judah's descendants.
